experiment: Same local lexical search and typed object-field extractor; vary whether the candidate must bind its fetched source to the requested run.
inputs: Two exact Git blobs containing previous synthetic learning and isolated recovery OCI receipts. Eleven cases frozen before candidate implementation.
limits: The caller supplies the run ID and field path. This measures source selection, typed scalar comparison and abstention for two known receipts. It does not measure natural-language field selection, institutional deployment, independent evaluation or student outcomes.
next: Evaluate natural-language field selection on independently authored prompts withheld from implementation, including ambiguous run identity, conflicting versions and absent fields. Score citations, wrong-source responses and abstention separately.
